fact: Madagascar told the UNHCR Executive Committee on 8 October 2025 that 89 people hold refugee status and about 1,200 are asylum seekers, that a national refugee office under the Interior Ministry handles asylum applications, and asked for support to develop identification and registration mechanisms.
title: Déclaration de Son Excellence Monsieur TEHINDRAZANARIVELO Djacoba A. S. Oliva, 76e session du Comité exécutif du Programme du Haut-Commissaire pour les réfugiés
